name: Sand Dollar
description: Sand dollars resting on the sea floor, each pale disc marked with its five-petal star of slots.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@r(0, 72)deg) scale(@rn(0.62, 1, 3)); transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@r(0, 72)deg) scale(@rn(0.62, 1, 3)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from -5deg, transparent 0deg 10deg, #000 10deg 72deg, transparent 72deg 82deg, #000 82deg 144deg, transparent 144deg 154deg, #000 154deg 216deg, transparent 216deg 226deg, #000 226deg 288deg, transparent 288deg 298deg, #000 298deg 360deg), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 70%, #000 70%); mask: conic-gradient(from -5deg, transparent 0deg 10deg, #000 10deg 72deg, transparent 72deg 82deg, #000 82deg 144deg, transparent 144deg 154deg, #000 154deg 216deg, transparent 216deg 226deg, #000 226deg 288deg, transparent 288deg 298deg, #000 298deg 360deg), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 70%, #000 70%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
